# #2053: Patch: the shop, pack and collection screens speak the reader's language — translated refusals and card names
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A reader playing in Chinese still hits English on the screens where they spend currency and manage their collection: server refusal messages on the shop, pack-opening and token pages render raw English ("that card is not yours" stays English even though the dictionary translates it), and card names on collection buttons, cosmetic labels and pickers render English while the card face beside them is drawn in Chinese. After this patch those surfaces speak the reader's language like the rest of the client.

## Why

Two gaps, one fix pattern. First: `wordsOf` (`apps/web/src/shop/Shop.tsx:31-33`) returns raw `cause.message`, rendered untranslated at `Shop.tsx:121,202`, `TokenPicker.tsx:103,130`, `CosmeticPacks.tsx:174,286`, `PackOpening.tsx:339,485` and `collection/TokenOffer.tsx:127` — while the convention wraps server sentences in `t()` (`auth/AccountError.tsx:67`, `game/Game.tsx:697`, `duos/CoopPanel.tsx:66`, `Marketplace.tsx:68`), the dictionary already holds the keys (`zh-CN.json:183` translates "that card is not yours"), and `t()` identity-falls back on unknown strings so wrapping is strictly non-regressive. Second: `def.name`/raw catalog names render at `OwnedCards.tsx:68` (aria-label), `CardCosmeticsView.tsx:112,308,319`, `CosmeticsPanel.tsx:27`, `TokenPicker.tsx:179`, `CosmeticPacks.tsx:58-59` and `cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx:147` — while `readerName`/`chineseName` is the convention everywhere else (`PoolGrid.tsx:159`, `DeckSidebar.tsx:138`, `PatchNotes.tsx:69`), which R711000 covers "in the collection alike".

## Proposal

Wrap the refusal renders in `t()`; render card names through `readerName(def)` (or `chineseName(id, name, def)` where only an id and name are held), matching the neighbouring convention. Any new client literal gains its `zh-CN.json` entry, which `i18n.test.ts` enforces.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/shop/`, `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`, `apps/web/src/collection/`, `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every listed error render goes through `t()`
- [ ] Every listed card-name render goes through `readerName`/`chineseName`, aria-labels included
- [ ] New client literals have dictionary entries; engine and server sentences keep their `{name}`-template fallback
- [ ] English rendering is unchanged

## Size and risks

Small: mechanical wrapping at about a dozen sites plus dictionary entries. No behaviour change for English readers; the only risk is a missed site, which a pass over `{error}`/`{loadError}` renders in the same directories closes.
